name: Duma
title: Ishmael's son
summary: Duma was one of Ishmael's twelve sons and thus a grandson of Abraham. He became the patriarch of an Arab tribe that bore his name. Duma is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles, and his name is also linked to a prophecy in Isaiah.

keyEvents.title: The Twelve Sons of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Dumah is mentioned as one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, who became patriarchs over their respective peoples.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Dumah is listed again among the sons of Ishmael in the great genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: God's Promise to Ishmael
keyEvents.description: God promised Abraham that Ishmael would become the father of twelve princes and a great nation, which included Dumah and his descendants.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Ishmael, Dumah's father, was born to Hagar, Sarah's Egyptian servant, as the son of Abraham.

keyEvents.title: The Prophecy about Dumah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Isaiah delivered an oracle called 'the burden of Dumah,' which contains a mysterious prophecy directed at the region of Seir, linked to Dumah's descendants.
